description: Should I keep, pause or kill this Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad? Give what one sale leaves the store before ad costs, what the ad has spent, and how many sales it brought, plus days running and link clicks if known. Returns keep, kill or too early, money up or down so far, the chance it really makes money, and the next step.

amount_spent.description: What the ad has spent so far.

days_running.description: Optional. Days the ad has been running. Under 3 days, a kill is held back unless the loss is already clear.

link_clicks.description: Optional. Link clicks on the ad. With no sales, fewer than 53 clicks is too few to judge unless the clicks themselves cost too much.

profit_per_sale.description: What one sale leaves the store before ad costs: price minus product, shipping, fees and returns (break-even CPA).

name: keep_or_kill
title: Keep or kill a Meta ad
